subject: Order Form: Pricing bands, invoice liability, and commit phasing playbook
messages:
From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@starlight.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@starlight.com
Date: 2026-08-01T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Order Form follow-up — invoicing & tax responsibility

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the redline earlier. Legal at Starlight had a quick pass and Procurement asked me to confirm a couple of items before we route back to our CFO:

1) Invoicing entity — the order form names Redwood, Inc. as the invoice issuer but our accounting needs to know if invoices can be issued to Starlight AI, Inc. (US entity) or if payments must route to Redwood Holdings (international). This affects our internal PO and tax mapping.

2) Net terms & early-stage ramp — we have a short pilot for Q4 (month 1–3) and need a clear invoice cadence of monthly vs. quarterly for the pilot and then a ramp to the committed minimums. Can you confirm whether Redwood can issue monthly invoices for the pilot and then switch to the committed cadence when the main tranche starts?

3) VAT/withholding evidence — our tax team requires a certificate of Redwood's tax residency and confirmation of whether Redwood will gross up in jurisdictions that withhold.

We'd like to finalize these points so our procurement/legal can complete the internal approval this week. Attaching our current PO template for reference.

Appreciate a short playbook or bullet list we can share internally.

Best,
Marta Ruiz
Procurement Manager — Starlight AI
[attachment: Starlight_PO_template_v2.docx (docx, 18KB)]

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@starlight.com>, procurement@starlight.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-01T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Order Form follow-up — invoicing & tax responsibility

Hi Marta — thanks for the clear list.  See answers below and a proposed operational playbook. I'm attaching a version of the order form with tracked commercial edits and a pricing schedule for the ramp.

Quick answers:
- Invoicing entity: Redwood can invoice Starlight AI, Inc. for US-bound contracts provided the order form includes the Starlight PO and remit instructions. If Starlight requires Redwood Holdings, we need the legal entity swap captured in the order form and a W-9 or equivalent.
- Net terms & pilot cadence: We can offer monthly invoices for the 90-day pilot, then transition to the committed cadence (per the pricing schedule) once the pilot converts. The transition will be indicated by a signed change note or countersignature on the order form amendment.
- VAT/withholding: Redwood will provide a tax residency letter and can accept the standard withholding treatment; Redwood does not automatically gross-up unless agreed in advance (we can include a gross-up clause in the order form appendix if needed).

Operational playbook (for Procurement/Finance):
1) Sign order form (template attached) with the "Invoice To" set to Starlight AI, Inc. and include your PO number in the billing field.
2) Pilot invoices: monthly, net 30 from invoice date; pilot SKU/usage billed at the pilot band rates in Pricing_Schedule_20260801.xlsx.
3) Conversion: When pilot completes and Starlight confirms conversion (email + countersignature), Redwood will issue a start-of-tranche invoice per the pricing schedule (first committed invoice pro-rated to the day the tranche starts).
4) Entity swap: If invoices must go to Redwood Holdings, Procurement to provide payment remit and tax form; Redwood legal (cc'd laura) will prepare a short amendment.
5) Withholding evidence: Redwood will upload tax residency certificate and W-8/W-9 as relevant to the shared drive link. Please confirm which document your AP needs.

Attachments: Redwood_OrderForm_v3_redline.pdf (redline), Pricing_Schedule_20260801.xlsx (pilot + committed bands).

@Ben — can you confirm the minimum commit ramp (months and amounts) we should propose if Starlight wants a 3-month pilot?

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Head of Commercial Ops | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
[attachment: Redwood_OrderForm_v3_redline.pdf (pdf, 85KB)]

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@starlight.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-02T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Order Form follow-up — invoicing & tax responsibility

Thanks Kim / Marta — quick follow-up from pricing:

Proposal for a pilot → commit ramp that keeps accounting clean and limits tax friction:
- Pilot (Months 0–2): monthly billing at pilot band (see Pricing_Schedule). Maximum monthly cap $15k USD.
- On conversion (Month 3 start): first committed invoice will be pro-rated to the conversion start date and include any overage from the pilot month.
- Commit structure (example): 6-month minimum commit at $50k/mo effective Month 3, with a 60% usage discount taper for months 1–2 of the committed phase if usage below threshold.

Invoice entity guidance: if Starlight requests Redwood Holdings as the remit name, we will require a signed amendment; otherwise, we will bill Redwood, Inc. to match our tax docs.

Action items for Starlight (to speed approval):
1) Confirm PO remit entity (Starlight AI, Inc. or alternate).
2) Confirm whether AP needs a tax residency cert + W-9/W-8.
3) If the PO requires a different remit name, confirm now so we can drop a short amendment and keep the doc timeline intact.

Laura — if you have any standard language for the gross-up option, please add.

Ben Carter
Sr. Sales Ops | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@starlight.com>

Subject: Re: Order Form follow-up — invoicing & tax responsibility

Kim / Ben — thanks for the clarity and the document attachments. Our CFO has asked for two small items before final countersignature:

- Please include a short clause in the order form appendix that allows Starlight to request a monthly invoice cadence during the first 90 days even if a longer cadence is selected for later tranches.
- We need Redwood's tax residency certificate and the W-9 on file (our AP won't process without both).

We are fine with the proposed pilot cap and the pro-rated commit invoice. I'll have our legal run the short appendix language and will return a DocuSign link by EOD tomorrow.

Appreciate you both — this should let us close next week.

Best,
Marta
Procurement Manager — Starlight AI
